name: plate_hx_correlations
title: Plate heat exchangers: heat-transfer and pressure-drop correlations (function library)
summary: Ten EES PROCEDUREs for the corrugated channel of a chevron plate heat exchanger: six single-phase correlations (Kumar, Thonon, Muley, Bogaerts, Martin, Wanniarachchi) and four two-phase condensation/flow-boiling correlations (Kuo-Lie-Hsieh-Lin, Hsieh-Lin, Yan-Lio-Lin, Han-Lee-Kim), each returning a heat-transfer coefficient and a pressure drop from the state, the mass flow rate and the plate geometry.

origin.notes: Procedure library of the ULiège plate-HX models, representative of duplicate group DG-0129 (TM-0583/TM-0584/TM-0585, C-121 triage); the near-identical martin procedure and its variant come from TM-0496 (~/Nextcloud/thermo_models/procedures EES/single phase hx  martin - SQ080229.EES, TM-0561 duplicate). Unit system already SI-°C-Pa-J. The Han procedure is transcribed but its call stays commented out as in the original (absurd pressure drops, see README).

verification.reference: EES stored solution of TM-0585 (38 common variables, compare_solution.py) plus ht 1.2.0 Python values of the HT-010 family (Martin VDI 4.6e-13, Kumar 9.0e-4 at the complementary chevron angle, Muley explained by the original file's phi^3 typo)
verification.notes: Maximum over all common variables is the R410A viscosity mu (5.83e-2, EES formulation vs CoolProp pseudo-pure model), which propagates through Re into the correlations (all outputs within 2.66e-2); geometry-only outputs (A_hex, T_sat) agree below 1e-6. Excluded as stale EES records of earlier runs: A_bar, L_p, mu_ratio, h, DELTAp, h_han, DELTAp_han.
